svg.title: Skiagraph: an SVG renderer for VMD
svg.desc: Protein: ubiquitin, PDB 1UBQ (Vijay-Kumar, Bugg and Cook, J. Mol. Biol. 194, 531, 1987). On the staff: its silhouette. 2.5D: Skiagraph's own SVG drawing of the banner's VMD scene, reduced to a few flat tones for small sizes. Figures: original drawings in the Attic black-figure manner.
